arms_not_used.2021 HF-only: batch-separated from the AF arm; used only as the HF-vs-control diagnostic below
arms_not_used.RA: sex-confounded (3/3 RA controls female) and 0 DEGs

chamber_and_arm_decision.primary: left atrium, 2020 sequencing batch only, AF vs control (batch-matched 5 vs 5)
chamber_and_arm_decision.why_2020_batch: every AF library is in the 2020 batch, so only a batch-matched control arm avoids confounding AF with the sequencing batch
chamber_and_arm_decision.why_left_atrium: AF has its own chamber-specific transcriptional programme; the paper reports 1,180 LA-vs-RA DEGs at baseline and pooling chambers loses power

cm_specificity.chamber_model: cardiomyocyte nuclei from left/right atria and ventricles; this item selects the left-atrium contrast only
cm_specificity.evidence: the series summary states a PCM1-based cardiomyocyte-specific nuclear isolation; every GSM's extract protocol says RNA was extracted from PCM1+ cardiomyocyte nuclei; the `molecule subtype` characteristic is "Cardiomyoyte-specific nuclear RNA" (sic)

confound.af_arm: AF + end-stage heart failure (transplanted hearts with documented AF)
confound.control_arm: non-failing donor hearts without HF or AF

hf_only_diagnostic.contrast: HF-CTL (2021-batch LA: 3 HF-only vs 5 new-heart controls)
hf_only_diagnostic.reading: HF alone produces at least as many DEGs as AF+HF does, so the AF arm cannot be read as HF-independent

confound.statement: AF-CTL measures AF+HF vs non-failing heart, so AF and HF are confounded; an AF-vs-HF-only contrast is not identifiable because the HF-only libraries are 2021-batch while AF is 2020-batch only. Recorded, not corrected.

AF-CTL.direction: positive log2FC = up in AF (+HF) vs control

deg_counts.definition: padj < 0.05 AND |log2FC| >= 2.0 in a declared contrast (ADR 0071); direction carried, not filtered

technical_replicate_subset.why: six columns of one sequencing run (technical replicates); no arm

method.filter: edgeR filterByExpr rule written out in the live worker
method.model: limma-voom (voom's own library-size normalisation, moderated t)

model_system: human atrial cardiomyocyte-nuclei bulk RNA-seq (PCM1+ FANS-sorted nuclei; CM-nuclear bulk, not pseudobulk)

samples.match_basis: series-matrix title core substring match against the matrix column name, asserted bijective

audit_model_alternative_edger_ql.method: edgeR quasi-likelihood F-test with TMM on the same 5 vs 5 LA contrast
audit_model_alternative_edger_ql.reading: the most liberal defensible test; recorded as a sensitivity only

audit_model_alternative_tmm.method: limma-voom after edgeR TMM normalisation (the pre-existing AF source audit model, not the live worker: the pinned arc R env ships limma but not edgeR, and the one live implementation uses voom's own library-size normalisation)
audit_model_alternative_tmm.reading: TMM is the only difference from the published fit; it moves LRRC10 from padj 0.0616 to 0.0344 and the v2 count from 1 to 2. Recorded per the one-live-implementation rule: the published number is the live worker's, never this one.

pooled_controls_batch_adjusted.contrast: AF-CTL, LA, 5 AF (2020) vs 10 controls (5 x 2020 + 5 new-heart 2021), ~0 + group + batch
pooled_controls_batch_adjusted.note: adds 2021-batch controls with batch as a covariate; it is a declared sensitivity, not the published contrast

series.batch_structure: AF libraries exist only in the 2020 batch, so the primary contrast is batch-matched; the 2021 addendum contributes HF-only libraries and extra controls
series.gsm_versus_column_discrepancy: 48 GSMs map to 38 library columns: the 2020 batch contributes 28 GSMs (27 with an expression row; GSM4103429/h76ra has none) and the 2021 addendum 20 GSMs; the addendum re-sequences four 2020 hearts (h77la, h77ra, h83la, h87ra), which are different sequencing runs of the same heart, not extra hearts. The 2785 matrix is a 6-column technical-replicate subset of one run.
series.title: Differential transcriptional responses in human cardiomyocytes
